sources.entry: Meetini - Meeting and interview assistant for Apple Silicon Macs with local captions, transcripts, meeting notes, and metered AI assistance. #paid

summary.name: Meetini
summary.one_liner: Meetini is an interview and meeting copilot for Apple silicon Macs that provides live answers, real-time coaching, mock interviews and meeting notes without a bot joining the call.
use_cases: practicing for a job interview with an AI interviewer
getting live hints during a video interview
coding and technical interview help from on-screen content
taking meeting notes and transcripts without a bot joining
capturing in-person conversations via Mac microphone
summary.what_it_does: Meetini runs on a Mac and captures call audio directly, without a meeting bot, to provide live captions, transcripts and meeting notes. During an interview it can give a direct answer or hint, show what to say next, and point out what worked and what to improve. It can read a chosen window or screen to help with coding and technical questions. Mock interviews let you practice coding, experience, system design or machine learning interviews against an AI interviewer based on your role.
notable: Captures audio directly on the Mac; no meeting bot or extra participant joins the call
Real-time coaching labels answers as Good, Improve and Say this
Hidden pop-out panels with screen-capture protection when sharing screen
Free 7-day Career trial with 60 AI minutes (card required)
caveats: Requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 14.2 or later; Model 1 needs macOS 26 or later
Trial requires a card and renews at paid rates unless cancelled in Billing before the trial ends
Mock interviews and AI assistance use metered AI minutes
